style: coherent detailed coastal Korean city for readable RTS; not toy blocks, not forest island; production target not accepted label

geography.preserve: OSM buildings/roads/rails/verified coast topology; historical source unmodified
geography.water: 12 open coastline ways must form boundary-connected water, never arbitrary closed roofs; do not surface culverted streams
geography.unverified: visual terrain/detail approximations distinct from calibrated solver geometry

exportContract.units: meters authored, +Y forward FBX conventional with manifest dimensions; root/worker use observed renderer bounds to fit intended geographic visual scale
exportContract.detail: bevels, varied silhouettes, layered surfaces, no detached primitives

worldRequirements: 6 distinguishable building archetypes driven by source tags/district, varied warm concrete/brick/glass, visible base/roof/entrance hierarchy
UV tiled asphalt/concrete/stone/green surfaces, shoulders/curbs, bounded lane markings and source intersections, rail track detail
Source-grounded parks/trees/quay/waterfront and three distinctive landmarks placed from source centroids; no trees on road/building/water polygons
Spatial mesh chunks and shared materials; bounded props budgets, report actual mesh/triangle/renderer counts
interiorRequirements: All3 Busan floors visually detailed from public facilityguide: circulation, repeated columns, walls/openings, stairs/escalators/lifts, hall furniture, ticketing/shops/platform canopy, Hangul wayfinding
Each layer can be viewed via existing SetFloor; roof hides for interior; avoid stacked solid floors obscuring active floor
Preserve FloorRoots/anchors/team/physics/controller bindings and existing local referencehall coordinates
No invented ventilation/fire-system precision or digital-twin validation
verification: One live build + district wide/mid/near captures, one interior cutaway capture per floor, actual renderer/mesh stats; no broad test rerun or solver rerun
